title: Autotransplantation versus Immediate Implant Placement for Replacement of Nonrestorable Posterior Teeth: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
html: The aim of the present systematic review and meta-analysis was to compare the clinical success rates of immediate dental implants (IMM) and autotransplanted mature teeth (AUT), and to identify patient-related and intraoperative factors that influence short-to mid-term outcomes.
